## Downloads

| Platform              | File                                    |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| Windows (x64)         | `Decktector_{{version}}_x64-setup.exe`  |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Decktector_{{version}}_aarch64.dmg`    |
| Linux (x64)           | `Decktector_{{version}}_amd64.AppImage` |

The installers are not code-signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. On macOS, allow the first launch from _System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway_, or run `xattr -cr /Applications/Decktector.app` in a terminal.
